news.title: General Mills Names Dana McNabb as CEO From January 2027
news.summary: General Mills (NYSE:GIS) has appointed Chief Operating Officer Dana McNabb as its next chief executive officer, succeeding Jeff Harmening from January 1, 2027. The company’s board of directors unanimously elected McNabb to the position, while Harmening will transition to executive chair of the board on the same date.
